conf.description: PACS Badge System (OnGuard Lnl_LoggedEvent class exemplar) access-events / api-pull: decode Time/AccessResult/Type+SubType at the edge worker group, derive event.id from PanelID+SerialNumber, hash CardNumber before it lands anywhere, leave the Lnl_* join-only fields unmapped (no lookup CSV available).

conf.comment: pacs-badge / access-events / api-pull (OnGuard OpenAccess REST collector on the edge worker group; re-key per deployed vendor - class exemplar only). Per recommendations.direct.cribl: derive event.outcome from the AccessResult enum, not the description string; concatenate PanelID+SerialNumber for a collision-safe event.id and Type+SubType for a stable event.code; tokenize/hash CardNumber before it lands in the index. Lnl_Reader.Name/Lnl_Account.AccountID/Lnl_Cardholder.LASTNAME require a join this environment has no lookup CSV for - left unmapped, see README.

functions.description: if the REST collector delivered raw JSON text, parse it; a collector that already emits structured fields leaves this a no-op

compute every derived field from the ORIGINAL vendor names before the rename below touches them: parse Time (CIM_DATETIME or ISO-8601) to _time, concatenate PanelID+SerialNumber into event.id, normalize Description into event.action, concatenate Type+SubType into event.code, map the AccessResult enum onto event.outcome, tag category/dataset
hash the badge/card number before it is renamed into pacs.badge.card_number - the primary correlation key is credential-adjacent and must not land in the index in the clear
redact the same card number if it still sits in _raw as JSON text (no-op if the collector never preserved a raw string), so the hashed field above isn't undermined by a plaintext copy alongside it
batch every clean-path field that is a straight copy to its ECS or custom target, run after the compute step and after CardNumber is already hashed
